sourceDate.text: 其夏，上立膠東王為太子

translationRepairs: In the second year of Yuanshi, Marquis of Xindu Wang Mang raised the fallen and continued the cut off; he informed the Grand Empress Dowager and established Nian’s younger brother’s son Ruyi as King of Guangzong, to serve the Filial Queen of Dai.

In the second year of Yuanshi, Marquis of Xindu Wang Mang raised the fallen and continued the cut off; he informed the Grand Empress Dowager and established Nian’s younger brother’s son Ruyi as King of Guangzong, to continue the ancestral sacrifices of King Xiao of Dai.
奉代孝王后 means to continue the sacrificial posterity of 代孝王 (King Xiao of Dai); the before misreads 后 as “queen” and invents a “Filial Queen of Dai,” while the proposed after restores the correct sense.
